name: 3357-sharegpt-7b-1gpu
model: huggyllama/llama-7b, fp16. Ungated, 6.7e9 parameters, ~13.5 GB of weights in two safetensors shards.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One in-process vLLM engine (guidellm `vllm_python`), no router, no external cache tier, no offload tier.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM (Llama-1 7B): 32 layers, hidden 4096, 32 query and 32 key/value heads (no GQA), head_dim 128, intermediate 11008, vocab 32000, max_position_embeddings 2048, fp16 -- read off the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=256 -- this engine's own `max-num-seqs`, so the scheduler is asked for a full batch on every step -- warm-up 600 requests by count, no cooldown, bounded at 2600 requests with a 3600 s safety cap, seed static 3357.
workload: guidellm `json_file`, `configs/data/sharegpt-llama7b-2600.jsonl`: 2600 single-turn ShareGPT conversations, the human turn as the prompt and the real assistant reply's length as the output length (prompt mean 242.5, median 95, p90 701, max 1024; output mean 243.9, median 167, p90 604, max 1850). Sampling temperature 1.0, top_p 1.0, top_k -1, n=1, no penalties, no logprobs, and `ignore_eos` so every request generates exactly its row's length. `request_format: plain` is required -- see the prose.
purpose: A general-purpose 7B chat assistant handling single-turn conversations at 256 concurrent streams on one H100.
launch:
# vLLM 0.3.3-era AsyncEngineArgs: an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction.
# Do not add keys from a later vLLM.
# READ LINE BY LINE: `key: value` only, and a value beginning `{` or `[` is read as JSON. An
# indented YAML block silently never reaches the engine args.

model: huggyllama/llama-7b
tensor-parallel-size: 1
pipeline-parallel-size: 1
dtype: float16
max-model-len: 2048

# The admission cap on the running batch. scenario.json offers exactly this many concurrent
# streams, so the two move together or neither does.
max-num-seqs: 256

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
block-size: 16
swap-space: 4
seed: 0
